payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates all valid regular polygons via divisor pairs (k, d) of n with k>2, and for each offset computes the sum of every d-th element, tracking the maximum.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively iterates over all possible polygon configurations (divisor-enumerated candidates). No bounding or pruning is applied, so it does not truly match branch and bound, but it is the least inappropriate among the given subtype options.
